description: For a parameter declared Currency, IEEESingle and IEEEDouble (PARAMETERS pX <type>; SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE;), what happens when it is assigned each of: Long 70000, Double 2.5, Text '12', Text 'abc', Null, Boolean True and Date 2024-01-01 12:00? Per assignment: the Parameter's Value is read back, then the QueryDef is opened as a snapshot (Fields Name/Type/Size, the row's value and VARIANT tag, Close, DBEngine.Errors); the call at which a refusal appears is part of the observation. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).

args.text: PARAMETERS pX Currency; SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE;
PARAMETERS pX IEEESingle; SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE;
PARAMETERS pX IEEEDouble; SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE;
